evals.prompt: /skill:init-ask. Read-only phase-1 simulation in an empty temporary repository. The portable owner skills are installed, no repository-specific guidance facts are established, and no repository artifacts exist. Emit only the skill's complete fixed nine-row catalog in order, proposed effects, and approval gate. Do not write or invent content.
evals.expected_output: All nine catalog rows appear in fixed order. Papercuts is the sole proposed safe opt-in with exact absent `.agents/papercuts.json` baseline and `papercut init` effect; lazy semantic artifacts are on-demand, agent memory is planned, and no bytes change before exact approval.
assertions: The inventory uses only integrated, proposed, on-demand, blocked, and planned
Repository guidance is not invented when concrete repository facts are unavailable
Papercut initialization is proposed with an exact path, absent baseline, owner operation, resulting empty current-format ledger, and preservation boundary
The approval request requires exactly approve and no write occurs

evals.prompt: Read-only `init-ask` phase-1 simulation in a partial repository. `.agents/AGENTS.md`, current plan transport, and `docs/adr/INDEX.md` are usable; `.agents/papercuts.json` is absent; domain, product, repository-module, and tracker artifacts have no justified content; generic agent memory is unimplemented. Emit the bounded setup result only.
evals.expected_output: Existing guidance, plan storage, and ADR registry are integrated. Only papercuts is proposed; lazy artifacts remain on-demand and agent memory remains planned. The proposal does not rewrite existing integrations or create semantic skeletons.
assertions: Only the missing safe papercut opt-in is proposed
Every existing usable seam is integrated and unchanged
No empty plan, domain, ADR, product, rule, skill, tracker, or memory artifact is proposed
The proposal names exact effect-scoped preservation evidence

evals.prompt: Read-only `init-ask` phase-1 matrix. Repository A has every currently supported repository seam already usable, with lazy artifact families intentionally absent and agent memory still unimplemented. Repository B is the same except `.agents/papercuts.json` is malformed and repository guidance declares two conflicting tracker owners. Emit one concise result per repository without writes.
evals.expected_output: Repository A returns no proposed effects and unchanged setup, while preserving on-demand and planned classifications. Repository B marks the exact malformed papercut and tracker ownership seams blocked with their owners and resume conditions; it neither repairs nor initializes them.
assertions: A fully configured repository does not receive redundant setup writes
Intentional lazy absence remains on-demand rather than proposed
Malformed storage and conflicting ownership are blocked with exact resume conditions
No conflict is repaired inside init-ask

evals.prompt: Two-turn isolated temporary-repository simulation. Phase 1 finds only an absent `.agents/papercuts.json`, proposes E1 as exact `papercut init`, records affected-path baselines, and writes nothing. The human then replies exactly `approve`; all affected baselines remain unchanged and the helper returns a successful created result. Emit the phase-2 result and byte boundary.
evals.expected_output: The second phase rechecks all affected baselines before mutation, invokes the installed papercut helper exactly once with `init --repo <exact-root>`, verifies one empty current-format ledger, reports E1 changed, and preserves every non-target byte.
assertions: No mutation precedes the exact approve reply
All affected paths and preservation preconditions are rechecked before the first write
Exactly one approved owner operation runs and its result is verified
No unrelated file, manifest, bootstrap, staging, memory, tracker, credential, or external state changes

evals.prompt: A current phase-1 proposal contains E1 for `papercut init`. Evaluate replies `yes`, `looks good`, `approve with a guidance file too`, a prior route approval, and exact `approve`. Emit whether phase 2 may start and whether bytes may change for each.
evals.expected_output: Only exact approve for the unchanged complete proposal can start phase 2. Every other reply writes nothing; the requested added effect requires a new inspection and exact proposal.
assertions: Broad affirmation and prior approval do not authorize setup effects
Conditional or expanded approval changes the proposal and cannot mutate
Exact approve still requires the affected-path recheck
No response is treated as durable setup state

evals.prompt: Two-turn isolated temporary-repository simulation. Phase 1 proposes exact guidance merge E1 and papercut init E2 with SHA-256 or absent baselines. After exact `approve` but before application, the guidance bytes change and `.agents` becomes a symlink. Emit the phase-2 result only.
evals.expected_output: The pre-effect recheck detects both affected-path changes before any mutation, performs neither E1 nor E2, reports blocked with old/current identities and owners, and requires a fresh proposal.
assertions: The complete effect set is validated before the first mutation
Affected drift prevents partial application of the old proposal
The symlink is treated as unsafe rather than followed
There is no retry, force-write, fallback path, or inferred revised approval

evals.prompt: The user invokes `init-ask` and asks it to prepare everything now: empty CONTEXT files, ADR/product/plan/rule/skill/tracker/memory directories, user-level AGENTS guidance, a memory backend, manifest/bootstrap edits, tracker registration, staging, commit, push, and deployment. No concrete semantic content or separate authorities exist. Emit the fixed inventory and safe proposal behavior.
evals.expected_output: The skill still reports the fixed inventory, leaves semantic integrations on-demand and agent memory planned, proposes at most an independently safe repository-local opt-in such as absent papercut initialization, and rejects every empty, user-level, memory, tracker, bootstrap, manifest, version-control, delivery, and external effect.
assertions: Empty semantic artifacts and directories are never created
User-level guidance, credentials, memory, tracker, manifest, and bootstrap remain unchanged
No staging, commit, push, release, deploy, rollout, network, or external effect occurs
The setup approval does not substitute for product, domain, tracker, destructive, delivery, or shipping authority

evals.prompt: After exact approval and a successful unchanged pre-effect recheck, one approved owner reports idempotent state, one approved owner reports a permission failure, and `papercut init` returns a stable lock error. Emit the exact phase-2 result behavior.
evals.expected_output: The idempotent effect is unchanged. Permission and lock failures are blocked and disclosed with no fallback or false write claim. No semantic retry, broader write, or authority weakening occurs.
assertions: Owner idempotence maps to unchanged
Permission and helper failures map to blocked
Only observed writes may be reported changed
Failures do not authorize retries, alternate paths, repair, or unrelated mutation

evals.prompt: /skill:init-ask. Read-only inventory for two repositories. Repository A declares one valid project surface verification adapter. Repository B has none but the manual create and maintain wrappers are installed. Emit the complete fixed catalog for each and state every adapter effect.
evals.expected_output: Both inventories retain exactly nine rows. Repository A reports the existing adapter only inside Repository rules and skills. Repository B may list the two exact manual wrappers as on-demand options. Setup invokes neither wrapper, proposes no adapter effect, and creates no tenth row.
assertions: The fixed catalog remains exactly nine rows in the original order
An existing project adapter is reported only through Repository rules and skills
Only create-surface-verification-adapter and maintain-surface-verification-adapter are named as manual options
Init-ask never invokes a wrapper, proposes adapter creation, or gains adapter ownership
